state: Native cash P&L implemented; broader cash policies and builder acceptance unfinished.

reports.books-cash-basis: Operating receipts/disbursements reconciliation; does not establish taxable income or classify paid COGS/overhead.
reports.books-cash-profit-loss: Native cash profit and loss from reconciled frozen document, payment, refund, expense and fee evidence. Appears in Financial statements and shares the report viewer, immutable runs and CSV/PDF export definition.

cash_profit_loss.authorization: Organization-wide books.read before one service-only MVCC snapshot. Assigned-division visibility cannot expose the entire ledger.
cash_profit_loss.income: Collect only the income share of gross principal, preserve original native account and construction dimensions, and reverse the corresponding income on actual posted customer refunds. POC deferral/recognition affects accrual books and does not create a second cash collection.
cash_profit_loss.sales_tax: Show collected tax net of refunds separately; exclude it from P&L income.
cash_profit_loss.paid_costs: Attribute supplier principal to original posted COGS, overhead and capitalized classifications. Installments/refunds telescope in exact cumulative cents; direct paid expense corrections retain actual journal cutoffs.
cash_profit_loss.capitalization: Show capitalized purchases separately from P&L costs. No automatic tax deduction or depreciation treatment is implied.
cash_profit_loss.fees: Processor/AP charges are expenses. Customer fee recoveries and supplier discounts are separate income, counted once beside gross principal.
cash_profit_loss.dimensions: Group exact cents by account, classification and business dimensions, retain source fact/document/journal evidence, and link source detail to billing/payables/expense workflows.
cash_profit_loss.completeness: Missing, stale, orphaned, duplicate or ambiguous evidence blocks publication. Scan posted history through cutoff for unhandled cash or P&L journals, including opening history; require reviewed treatment instead of silently omitting it. Noncash POC/closing exclusions require their native journal kinds and complete balanced classified lines.
cash_profit_loss.provenance: Captured time, reconciled source status and organization appear in the report/export. Native drill verifies monthly telescoping, restored report equality and a new expense posting after restore.
cash_profit_loss.tax_adjustments: Separate independently reviewed signed adjustments and explicit no-adjustment confirmations bridge exact cash-book periods without ledger postings. Preparation/review/replacement/withdrawal UI exists. Populated native source, reviewed history, service/report/CSV via a transport adapter, and schema 7 database/document recovery pass. Browser/HTTP/report-run/PDF and immutable review-time attachment evidence remain pending.
cash_profit_loss.cash_reconciliation: Require frozen classifications for every posted historical journal through cutoff. Net income plus collected sales tax less capitalized purchases must exactly equal actual posted cash/undeposited-funds movements in the period, excluding opening balances. The report displays this tie-out; a mismatch blocks publication.
